note: PLATE GATE of 8947 (Liber Ecclesiasticus), 2026-08-29. Migne PL 113, on-disk scan raw/scans/pl113/patrologiaecurs04migngoog.pdf, PDF page = (column + 11) / 2, calibrated against the printed corner numbers before every read. Second witness for the clipped left column: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w, f = (column + 1) / 2. ALL 22 PAGES BEARING A MARKER WERE READ, covering all 69 markers (56 [var:], 13 [sic:]). Every site below was re-verified at 600 dpi before patching.
class: TWO DIRECTIONS, on purpose. (1) CORRUPTED -- Corpus Corporum broke a word Migne set correctly; repaired, and the [sic:] that accused Migne of it is WITHDRAWN. Nine of this work's thirteen [sic:] markers were false in exactly this way. (2) NORMALIZED -- Corpus Corporum silently tidied a defect in Migne's own type; restored so a [sic:] can show it (Pattern 7). Four defects of Migne's were hidden from us this way, and no check we run could have found them: our Latin is not the printed page.
result: 56/56 [var:] CONFIRMED on the plate. 4/13 [sic:] confirmed and standing (magnituditudinem 1184C, obsentiamus 1197A, reconciliatione 1207A, erudiunmultos 1210D). 9/13 [sic:] FALSE and withdrawn. 4 new [sic:] owed for defects CC had repaired.
